# Frozen reference — OCPP Parser v2026.05.14

This is a **read-only frozen copy** of the original OCPP Client Log Parser as it
existed before the TypeScript + Vite revamp.

- **Captured:** 2026-06-14
- **Source:** `src/app/OCPP_Parser_Complete_ 21 Jan'26.html` (in-tool version `2026.05.14`, 9,813 lines, ~620 KB)
- **Why kept:** behavior/UI reference for the new modular parser (`feat/parser-revamp`).
  The new build must match this tool feature-for-feature (see `specs/requirements.md`),
  optimized and with known bugs fixed. This copy is the parity baseline.

**Do not edit.** It is preserved exactly as shipped. The live tool continued to
deploy from the canonical source until the revamp reached parity.
